answer: LINE-SGD is faster because, on the language network, it uses a much simpler objective and update rule than graph factorization: it optimizes only local pairwise edge information with negative sampling, avoids expensive matrix-factorization-style computations over the whole graph, and can be trained efficiently with ordinary SGD using sparse, edge-based updates. This makes each iteration cheaper and the optimization more scalable on large networks.
